TGA_specimen_preparation: sheet aliquot; mass, cutting and grinding not reported
title: Effects of Anchovy, Mussel, and Shrimp Powders on the Flame Retardancy of Bacterial Cellulose
treatment_chemistry: anchovy powder (50 wt% relative to BC), citric acid crosslinker and sodium hypophosphite catalyst
treatment_method: Original kombucha BC was washed, bleached and swollen according to cited protocols; upstream recipe is not repeated. Dissolve 50 wt% anchovy powder relative to BC in distilled water at BC:liquid 1:10 w/v. Add citric acid at 10% w/v and sodium hypophosphite at crosslinker:catalyst molar ratio 1:1. Stir at 25 +/-2 C for 30 min, adjust to pH 10.0 +/-0.5 with 1 N NaOH, and denature at 80 C for 20 min with shaking at 80 rpm. Cool to 25 +/-2 C; immerse BC, ultrasonicate at 25 C for 30 min, shake at 30 C for 1 h at 80 rpm, cure at 160 C for 5 min and dry at 25 C for 24 h.
